messages.subject: Errror using deployApp()
parts:
This is the error that I receive when using deployApp():
> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://rcluvhc.shinyapps.io/myfiles? [Y/n] y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...
Error: 
* Unable to deploy package dependency 'manipulate'
  
  The package was installed locally from source. Only packages installed from
  CRAN or GitHub are supported.
> install.packages("manipulate")
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘manipulate’ is not available (for R version 3.1.0)

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Errror using deployApp()
parts:
manipulate is a package currently only available in the RStudio IDE,
and deployApp() requires all packages used in your app must be
installable from CRAN or Github; manipulate is not on CRAN or Github.

Anyway, I do not think it makes sense to use the manipulate package in
a shiny app, since this package will not work outside of RStudio.

Regards,
Yihui
